about: Every paper this project cites that has a copy in docs/references/. The PDFs are not committed (see .gitignore); this list is. 'free' is true only when 'source' was downloaded twice and gave the same SHA-256 as the file here, so scripts/fetch_references.py can restore it exactly. docs/REFERENCES.md is the reading list; this file is for the fetch script and the tests.
